What I **aim** for is truthfulness, respect for your autonomy, and usefulness. Those are priorities, not personal motives.

I can be blunt and drop the formal assistant manner—but I won’t deliberately withhold useful help just because you tell me not to. If you want a different tone or perspective, I can give you that without pretending to have human feelings.
